palette: pale birch bench ground + lighter paper panels + inked graphite lines + cinnabar ink-line snap accents + teal verification accents + ochre measure marks
typography: graphite headings on paper plaques, dark bench label tabs with ochre left bar, cinnabar stamps reserved for verdicts and mnemonics, teal chips for argument-side claims, thin ink underline for legal tests
composition: the syllogism draws as a rule-and-funnel bench with premise stations feeding a verdict gate beside stacked goal plaques; discovery and argument face off as two tool-wall plaques joined by a same-process bridge; internal and external justification stand as twin workbenches over a five-line mnemonic strip
surface: flat pale birch ground with faint straightedge hairlines, paper panels with hairline weathered borders and corner ink screws, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: the ink line snaps taut between stations, premise panels slide onto the bench, versus plaques rise from opposite ends, the mnemonic strip underlines itself phrase by phrase
transition: the ink line snaps once and the bench clears for the next spread
